Services

Problem-Oriented Engineering Services

Not generic. Each service solves a real industrial challenge — from first concept through certified component delivery.

// 01

3D Mechanical Design & Product Development

Complete 3D modeling, DFM analysis, FEM validation, ASME drawings and GD&T. Manufacturing-ready package from concept sketch.

  • SolidWorks / Inventor / Solid Edge
  • Exploded views & technical drawings
  • FEM validation & structural analysis
  • Manufacturing drawings & complete BOM
  • Weld, machining & assembly drawing packages
  • ASME Y14.5 GD&T documentation
SolidWorksInventorFEMGD&TBOM
// 02

CAM Programming & Advanced CNC Machining

Toolpath generation and G-code programming for multi-axis CNC. Optimized for cycle time, surface quality, tool life and critical tolerances.

  • NX CAM / HyperMILL / Mastercam
  • 3, 4 & 5-axis programming
  • Milling, turning, molds, prototypes
  • Cycle time & toolpath optimization
NX CAMHyperMILLMastercamG-Code
// 03 — SPECIALTY

Precision Parts Fabrication — Tolerances, Geometries & Applications

Engineering and manufacturing of precision steel components from raw material to finished part. Complete dimensional, geometric and application analysis.

  • Critical tolerances: IT5-IT8 (±0.005 mm)
  • GD&T: flatness, roundness, runout, parallelism
  • Materials: 4140, 4340, 316L, tool steel, alloys
  • Surface finish: Ra 0.4 – 3.2 µm
  • Load, fatigue and environment validation
  • Gears, shafts, flanges, downhole tools
IT TolerancesGD&T4140 SteelRa FinishCMM
// 04

Structural Analysis & FEM Simulation

FEA, stress and deformation simulation, material selection and design validation before production — eliminating costly rework.

  • Static, dynamic & thermal FEA
  • SolidWorks Simulation / MATLAB
  • Fatigue & fracture analysis
  • Safety factor & material optimization
FEA/FEMSW Sim.MATLABStress
// 05

Oil & Gas Engineering & API Compliance

Design and validation of drilling components, downhole tools and tubular goods under API and Bureau Veritas standards.

  • API 7-1 / 7-2 / 5DP / 5CT / 5B
  • Bureau Veritas DS-1 Vol. 1-5
  • Thread design & gauging
  • Downhole tool validation
API 7-1DS-1ASME IXBV
// 06

Steel Cost Engineering & Manufacturing Calculation

Complete cost calculation for raw steel transformation into finished industrial products — material, machining, heat treatment, surface finish and quality inspection.

  • Raw material to finished part costing
  • BOM, scrap factor & quotation
  • Heat treatment & surface finish costs
  • Competitive manufacturing quotation delivery
Cost Eng.BOMSteel GradesQuotation

Capabilities

Technical Capabilities

A comprehensive set of engineering competencies built through 5+ years of real industrial project delivery.

▲

3D Design & Modeling

Full parametric 3D modeling, assemblies, exploded views, surface modeling and manufacturing-ready drawing packages.

△

Manufacturing Drawings & BOM

Complete 2D drawing packages with GD&T, weld symbols, machining notes, surface finish callouts and structured Bills of Materials for production.

↻

CAM Programming

Multi-axis toolpath generation, G-code programming, tool selection and cutting parameter optimization for 3, 4 and 5-axis machines.

⬢

FEM Simulation & Analysis

Static and dynamic structural analysis, thermal simulation, fatigue studies and safety factor validation before any prototype is built.

◆

Precision Tolerancing & GD&T

Critical tolerance specification using ASME Y14.5 and ISO GPS — flatness, cylindricity, runout, profile and position controls.

△

Standards & Normative Compliance

Engineering work referenced under API, ASME, ASTM, ISO, ANSI and SAE — material qualification, dimensional inspection and documentation.

■

Steel Cost Engineering

Complete cost breakdown from raw steel billet to finished component — machining, heat treatment, surface finish, scrap factors and quotation.

DFM & Product Development

Design for Manufacturability analysis from the earliest stage — reducing tooling cost, cycle time and assembly complexity before production.
